page: Amazon Web Services c9gd.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor platform. It features 64 dedicated physical cores running on the arm64 64-bit AWS Graviton processor architecture at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1:1 core-to-thread topology, all 64 vCPUs represent physical execution resources without hyperthreading overhead. The instance comes equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, offering a compute-dense ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

For localized storage requirements, the c9gd.16xlarge integrates 3,800 GB of directly attached local NVMe SSD storage. Data movement across distributed nodes is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 34 Gbps. The absence of complimentary public IPv4 addressing aligns with deployment within private subnets behind network gateways or load balancers.

From an architectural standpoint, the c9gd.16xlarge provides resource density by pairing custom arm64 processing units with local ephemeral storage. By eliminating simultaneous multithreading, it guarantees execution performance per core. Tradeoffs include the requirement of compiling software for the arm64 architecture and managing non-persistent local storage volumes.

The instance profile suits compute-bound workloads requiring local disk access. Typical application fits include distributed data processing, web serving, continuous integration and deployment pipelines, search indexing, and real-time analytics engines.
description: Amazon Web Services c9gd.16xlarge is a compute-optimized, arm64-based cloud server powered by custom 3.3 GHz AWS Graviton processors. Operating on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, it provides 64 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core configuration, avoiding hyperthreading overhead. The system features 128.0 GB of memory, maintaining a compute-focused ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. To support I/O-intensive workloads, the instance bundles 3,800 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and delivers a 34 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile. This hardware combination offers significant compute density and local disk throughput. The instance is designed for execution within private cloud subnets, as it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The c9gd.16xlarge is fit for batch processing, distributed analytics, containerized CI/CD build pipelines, and database processing.
